title: Independent adversarial review of the F6-R10 signal-handling fix gating the Story 1.2 re-freeze
summary: Perform a fresh read-only adversarial review of the F6-R10 correction in which the operation lock's release moved to the EXIT trap alone while INT and TERM handlers disarm and exit, so a signalled run can never continue writing after freeing the lock. Independently attack every signal-landing case including double signals, signals inside the release itself, signals during rollback and recovery, interactions with the publication-window wait and vanished-record handling, and the untrapped SIGHUP shape. Evaluate the five documented residual risks, verify the 61 new regressions are genuine and anti-vacuous against a pre-fix reconstruction, re-verify all prior F6-R1 through F6-R9 semantics survived, then rerun every Story 1.2 gate including loaded mutation runs and git diff --check. This review gates the story re-freeze and the resumption of the held merge stack. Report findings only; do not modify repository files.
